## 1. Objective Function
*What is the explicit goal of this task? What is the dominant variable we are trying to optimize?*

## 2. Objects & Operators
* **Objects:** (What are the atomic units we are manipulating? e.g., Python scripts, 3D printer hotend, desk layout)
* **Operators:** (What tools or actions are available to modify the objects?)

## 3. Boundary Conditions & Constraints
* (What are the limits? e.g., Must run in under 5 seconds, budget is $100, must not alter existing API)

## 4. Invariants
* (What must REMAIN TRUE during and after this task? e.g., The 4-Cartesian-arm baseline must remain neutral)

## 5. Failure Modes
* (What are the expected ways this could break or fail to meet the objective?)

## 6. Minimal Test Case (Acceptance Criteria)
* (What is the deterministic test or explicit checklist that proves this task is complete?)
  - [ ] Criteria 1
  - [ ] Criteria 2
